description: This file implements the 'Add' feature for favoriting articles within an ASP.NET Core application, including request validation, handling logic, and database interactions.

classes.name: Add.Command
classes.description: Represents the request to add an article to favorites, containing the article slug.

classes.name: Add.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the command's slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: Add.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the logic to add an article to favorites and returns the enriched article data.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the add to favorites request by fetching the article and user, creating favorite association if not exists, and returning the article envelope.
